text: Lawyers in different firms may split a fee, if the total is reasonable, in one of three ways: by services performed (with the client told and not objecting), under a separation or retirement agreement between former colleagues, or on a referral where each lawyer takes the same responsibility as a partner.

payDifferences: Adds safeguards to the reciprocal exception (client informed consent, no interference with independent judgment, client information protected) and has no nominal-gift exception.
